extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: Abell 2029 (z=0.0773). Sohn, Geller, Zahid, Fabricant, Diaferio & Rines 2017, ApJS 229, 20 ('The velocity dispersion function of very massive galaxy clusters: Abell 2029 and Coma'). 982 rows, ALL of which are spectroscopically confirmed cluster MEMBERS - this table is a members-only catalogue, so N_total_z = N_members = 982 by construction. Redshift is given as cz in km/s (converted to z=cz/c in the cleaned file). Instrument: MMT/Hectospec, 3700-9150 Angstrom, 6.2 Angstrom resolution, observed 2016 April-June; supplemented by SDSS and literature (column r_cz). Selection function: magnitude-limited SDSS r-band targeting within the 1 deg Hectospec field; no colour preselection. The table additionally carries a central stellar velocity dispersion (sigma, rest-frame 3 kpc aperture) and Dn4000 per galaxy - these are INTERNAL galaxy dispersions, NOT the cluster velocity dispersion, and must not be confused with it. Sky coverage: members extend to ~65 arcmin (~5.9 Mpc projected); 90% within ~3.5 Mpc.
